tasks.description: T-C2: the single most informative measurement still missing in this thread, and the only way the current standstill breaks. Every existing slack number in this project comes from a solve truncated at one iteration, because all four v34u cells were constructed with effective ipopt.max_iter=1 and returned Maximum_Iterations_Exceeded / SOLVER_RET_LIMITED. Within-cell objective reconstruction is verified and must NOT be re-litigated. What is NOT established is whether converged optimal slack is zero or positive, and no converged objective-contract measurement exists. Frozen inputs: opened development context source242_slot0_branch_start ONLY, term_mode V15_shared, goal case.tvp.trajectory_endpoint[61], cells H12/H15/H35 canonical plus H15 goal_facing. IPOPT at PRODUCTION tolerances (max_iter NOT forced to 1) for all four cells, plus EXACTLY ONE forced max_iter=1 truncated control, and that control must be the H12 cell only. Five scheduled low-level solver calls. MANDATORY SETUP ASSERTIONS, reported as pass/fail facts and not as narrative: (a) for each arm the intended primal initialization is actually written at solver entry, proven by a real pre-solve opt_x_hash for each arm and a nonzero assignments_succeeded count; (b) the H15 canonical versus H15 goal_facing pair is matched on effective parameters, terminal coefficients, bounds, scaling, previous input and dual initialization, with declared per-entry differences recorded for any item that cannot be matched; (c) the two H15 arms must NOT both enter the solver from identical pre-solve state, because identity would mean the intervention again failed to apply. HARD NEW GATE: if any arm records assignments_attempted=0 / assignments_succeeded=0, or if the two H15 arms enter with identical pre-solve opt_x_hash AND identical opt_p_hash, the run is an INERT-INTERVENTION FAILURE: record it, spend no further calls, and return to the lead immediately without producing an initialization-sensitivity claim. This gate exists because the historical v34u goal_facing arm recorded assignments_attempted=0, assignments_succeeded=0 with pre-solve opt_x_hash 5b251505436d130331c07e9ebb9f06c5fbd90f60fe734f07dad6f175148921b7 IDENTICAL to the canonical H15 arm while its effective parameter hash differed, and the earlier wrapper returned success anyway. Required per-cell outputs: return_status and unified_return_status, actual iteration count, J_solver, J_recon_historical_noeps, J_recon_full and both relative errors against the predeclared thresholds, direct NLP f evaluated at the returned opt_x_num/opt_p_num compared to opt_f_num, the PERSISTED PER-STAGE EPSILON VECTOR for all k and all j WITH ITS LABEL AND DIMENSION, eps_nonzero_count, per-stage gamma^k*1000*epsilon contributions, the soft-margin quantity 1.5*r_obstacle - d, hard obstacle clearance, and an explicit verdict on whether any epsilon is materially non-zero at convergence. Also report solver_wall_s and whole_decision_get_action_wall_s as mean/median/P95 with n, and state that no truncated cell's timing is a deployable estimate. Predeclared acceptance: converged full-objective relative error <= 1e-6; the H35 1e-5 allowance applies only if H35 is documented non-converged BEFORE the run; any converged cell above 1e-4 is a hard defect that stops the task. Branch rules: all four cells converge with relative error <= 1e-6 -> close OC-epsilon-1 as a verified IMPROVED formula amendment, release dependent contract-consumer work, and state the converged-slack verdict either way, because positive converged slack falsifies only the universal zero-slack hypothesis and is NOT a defect; converged miss in 1e-6 to 1e-4 -> record as a SECOND distinct residual source under a new stable ID and do not proceed; any converged cell above 1e-4 -> hard defect, stop, escalate to lead. Submit at most 3 attempts total for this task; deliberate correctness repetitions are permitted but each repetition consumes the shared author/critic reasoning-effort budget. Negative and null results are first-class outputs and must be preserved verbatim. No plant steps, no env.step/reset after construction, no training, no refit, no validation64, no sealed test.
